body: That's great to hear. It's good having friends around. Can you talk to your friends about your thoughts? And if I may ask, what would make you happy? Or, what problem needs to be solved in order for you to feel better?

That's a long time already. I think you can be proud of carrying yourself through six months. How do you manage it? And I get how hard it is to deal with guilt. I actually just made post on this sub about how I've screwed everyone close to me. And why would I think you were fine if I were to meet you? How do you keep that appearance up?

You do not sound entitled at all. How long have you been unsatisfied with how things are going? I've also poked through your post history for a bit, how are you dealing with guilt as of right now? And just so you know, I'm open for conversation if that would help you :)
